title: This filter wants your whole camera roll
scenario: A trending AI photo app promises a “future self” image. Before it works, it asks for full photo-library access, contacts and precise location, even though you only want to upload one selfie.

answers.A: Allow everything once, create the image, then revoke permissions immediately.
answers.B: Deny unnecessary permissions and use an app that allows selecting only the photo needed.
answers.C: Check the app’s privacy information and ask a trusted adult before granting broad access.

explanation: Data can be copied the moment permission is granted. Temporary access can still be enough to collect more than the feature needs.
proTip: “I’ll revoke it later” is not the same as “they never got it.”
